sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 147.09M and the prices on this page come from the confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC). ⭐ THE LEAD IN THE WINNER CONTRACT CHANGED HANDS: Flávio Bolsonaro is at 52.85% (vol USD 10.17M accumulated) and Lula at 43.50% (vol USD 10.46M), against 46.25% and 52.50% in the confirmed reading of 09/Sep. That is 6.60pp up for one and 9.00pp down for the other, and the 6.25pp gap that favoured Lula yesterday became 9.35pp the other way. 📈 The 52.85% is the highest point in Flávio Bolsonaro's series, which opens on 14/Apr/2026 and holds 506 recorded readings, above yesterday's 45.80%.
sentimento.text2: TODAY'S NATIONAL POLL IS THE PODERDATA/AYA (BR-04914/2026, fieldwork from 06 to 09/Sep, n=3,000, margin of 1.8pp, 623 municipalities across the 27 federal units). In the first round it measures Lula 38%, Flávio Bolsonaro 36%, Augusto Cury 10%, Renan Santos 3%, Ronaldo Caiado 2% and Pablo Marçal 2%. In the runoff it gives 47% to Flávio Bolsonaro against 45% for Lula, and this is the SEVENTH consecutive national result since 06/Sep in which Lula does not lead that pairing. ⚠️ The two-point gap fits inside two margins of 1.8 in both scenarios, so what the pollster measures is a statistical tie. 🆕 The same round brings a new pairing, with Augusto Cury ahead of Lula by 44% to 43%.
sentimento.text3: BOTH MEASUREMENTS POINT THE SAME WAY TODAY, AND THE DIFFERENCE IN INTENSITY IS THE FINDING: the market moved 15.60pp in the gap within 24 hours and the poll measures two points inside the margin. The page records both without saying which one is right, and without subtracting one from the other, because a price is the probability of winning the election and a poll is declared voting intention. 📌 The context of the day is at the Supreme Court: the Federal Police executed warrants in the case of the financing of the film Dark Horse, authorised by Flávio Dino, and Edson Fachin cancelled the plenary session for the second day running. The page records the acts and does not claim they explain the price.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 52.85% (vol USD 10.17M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, up 6.60pp against the price confirmed on 09/Sep, and the lead of the book. It is the highest point in his series, which opens on 14/Apr/2026 and holds 506 recorded readings. In the second-place contract for the first round he FELL 7.00pp and stands at 71.50% (vol USD 718 thousand), a move consistent with the rise in the winner contract.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 43.50% (vol USD 10.46M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, down 9.00pp against the price confirmed on 09/Sep, and the loss of the lead. It is his largest single-day move in the series, and it leaves him 24.00pp below his own top of 67.50% on 16/Aug and 9.00pp above the floor of 34.50% on 25/Apr. In the second-place contract for the first round he ROSE 4.90pp and stands at 24.50% (vol USD 578 thousand).
sentimento.terceiraVia: ⚠️ Augusto Cury is at 0.35% in the winner contract, reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, and at 49.25% (vol USD 150 thousand) in the third-place contract for the first round, where he is the favourite. Renan Santos is at 2.15% in the winner contract, with USD 13.15M accumulated, the largest individual volume in the presidential book, and at 42.50% in the third-place contract. Ronaldo Caiado has 0.25% and 5.00%. 🗳️ In today's PoderData/Aya, Augusto Cury has 10% in the first round, his highest figure in the national polls of this window.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT (17:20 UTC). ⭐ In this round the winner contract, the second-place contract for the first round, the third-place contract and the Supreme Court impeachment contract received new prices. ⛔ The Senate contract receives no new price in this round. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp.

inss.text1: 📌 THERE IS NO NEW INSS ACT ON 10/Sep. The subject remains tied to the Federal Police crisis by the same thread as 09/Sep: the director-general removed on 08/Sep and reinstated on 09/Sep is the same one who led the investigation into fraud in pension deductions.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: The Federal Police operation of 10/Sep on the financing of the film Dark Horse does not concern the INSS, and the page does not merge the two cases. What links them is the institution in the middle, not the object of the investigation.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval remains the Genial/Quaest of 07/Sep, with fieldwork from 03 to 06/Sep: 43% approve and 50% disapprove. There was no new approval round on 10/Sep, and the panel keeps one pollster per block on purpose, so that the internal series does not mix.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture stopped being one of stillness. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48%, and on 07/Sep 43% against 50%. That is 5 points of decline in approval and 3 points of rise in disapproval in about a month, measured by the same pollster with the same design.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is narrow: there was no new INSS act on 10/Sep, and government approval still rests on the reading of 07/Sep. The movement of the day is in the market and at the Supreme Court, not here.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 10/Sep: the Federal Police executed warrants in the investigation into the financing of the film Dark Horse, authorised by Flávio Dino, and the central target according to the force is former secretary Mario Frias. Weapons were seized at his home, and the police question the origin of R$ 645 thousand passed to the production (Folha de S.Paulo, Gazeta do Povo, Poder360 and CartaCapital, all on 10/Sep).
bancoMaster.text2: Dino ordered precautionary measures the same day, among them a ban on Mario Frias leaving the country and on contacting other people under investigation (Folha de S.Paulo, Valor Econômico and CartaCapital, 10/Sep). The decision points to evidence of diversion of public funds through parliamentary earmarks directed to organisations linked to the production company.
bancoMaster.text3: 📌 THE CHRONOLOGY MATTERS AND IT HAS THREE DIFFERENT DATES: the plea agreement of the operator of the transfers came out on 03/Sep, its approval by André Mendonça was on 09/Sep, and the operation of 10/Sep is the next act. Flávio Bolsonaro described the operation as an attempt at political interference (Folha de S.Paulo and VEJA, 10/Sep), and the panel records the statement without endorsing it.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved from formalised cooperation to the search and seizure stage, with precautionary measures against a name linked to the surroundings of the campaign that leads the winner contract. On the same day that contract rose 6.60pp and reached the top of its series. The page records both facts and does not claim a link between them.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on 10/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, alongside Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: No new individual act on 10/Sep. ⚠️ The extraordinary session that examines the request to investigate him is scheduled for 15/Sep, and it is to that session that Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão tie this week's cancellations. According to Folha, he prepared a public statement and postponed it.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act on 10/Sep. His request for more time, on 08/Sep, in the virtual session examining the removal of the Federal Police leadership, became moot with the reinstatement ordered on 09/Sep.
stf.dino: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 10/Sep: he authorised the Federal Police operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse and ordered precautionary measures against Mario Frias, among them a ban on leaving the country and on contacting other people under investigation. The decision points to evidence of diversion of public funds through parliamentary earmarks. On 09/Sep he had already reversed the removal of the Federal Police leadership.
stf.mendonca: No new individual act on 10/Sep. On 08/Sep he removed the Federal Police leadership for 90 days, a decision reversed by Flávio Dino on 09/Sep, and on 09/Sep he approved the plea agreement of the businessman who operated transfers to the film's fund.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. In three days one justice removed the Federal Police leadership, another reversed the removal, a third approved a plea agreement about the financing of a film tied to the surroundings of one of the campaigns, and the president of the Court cancelled two consecutive plenary sessions. The session that decides on the request to investigate a justice is scheduled for 15/Sep, less than a month before the first round.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 FELL 0.50pp and stands at 4.35% (vol USD 88 thousand), confirmed reading of 10/Sep, 2:20 PM BRT. It sits 14.95pp below the top of its series, 19.30% on 04/Sep, and 2.25pp above the floor of 2.10% on 08/Jun. 📌 What is left to read is that the book gave back almost all of the rise it made at the start of the month, even with the institutional crisis still under way, and its volume of USD 88 thousand is small enough for isolated orders to move the price.
stf.fachin: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 10/Sep: he cancelled the plenary session for the SECOND day running (Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo, Estadão, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). The first cancellation was on 09/Sep. The extraordinary session that examines the request to investigate Alexandre de Moraes remains scheduled for 15/Sep.
